The finite-dimensional gauge-slice definition, local Jacobian theorem, and two worked examples are in [the definition](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/items/def-qftx-gauge-slice-and-faddeev-popov-operator.md>), [the theorem](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/items/thm-qftx-local-faddeev-popov-slice-jacobian.md>), [the translation example](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/items/ex-qftx-translation-gauge-slice-jacobian.md>), and [the SO(2) example](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/items/ex-qftx-so2-gauge-slice-multiplicity.md>). Both pages are frontmatter-only. The three direct batch 2 item dependencies and the gauge-geometry page dependency are recorded as verified in the [cross-batch evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-3.cross-batch-dependencies.json>).

## Checks and remaining blockers

Scoped content-policy, rendercheck, depcheck, strict proof-contract validation, and proof-layout checks passed. The four declared item dependency levels also match their computed levels.

The full planned A page remains incomplete: the Singer theorem has no carrier because the exact hypotheses and proof could not be read. After the earlier five failures, a search surfaced the [Project Euclid PDF](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/communications-in-mathematical-physics/volume-60/issue-1/Some-remarks-on-the-Gribov-ambiguity/cmp/1103904019.pdf), but opening and screenshot attempts returned no readable paper. This escalation and its access history are in the [source coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-3.coverage.json>); no further Singer attempts will be made.

`source-fetch-check --stamp` stamped the full [Skinner lecture notes](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/dbs26/AQFT/chap8.pdf), but returned zero bytes on five attempts for the [Mitter–Viallet mirror](https://scispace.com/pdf/on-the-bundle-of-connections-and-the-gauge-orbit-manifold-in-1nks9qpdkj.pdf). I read that paper in the web view; its fetch stamp remains unresolved. Overall, the source check stamped 1/3 sources.

Run-wide checks are also blocked by other batches: proof-contract coverage encounters the empty `qftx-equivariant-index` inventory; dependency validation reports 76 empty inventories and 12 level mismatches, none in this batch; and the overall Step 1 check remains open. I left shared batch evidence unchanged.
